profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Goldman Sachs | Snowflake Cloud, Python
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Goldman Sachs benefits from contributions to its Asset Management Data Warehouse team, where the focus is on leveraging Snowflake Cloud, Snowpark, and Looker to optimize financial data management. These efforts align with the organization's commitment to innovation and efficiency in asset management.  

Graduating from the University of San Francisco with a B.S. in Computer Science, prior experience includes internships at SEO (Sponsors for Educational Opportunity) and as a Teaching Assistant. These roles honed technical expertise and built a foundation for collaboration and problem-solving in data-centric roles, fostering impactful contributions to financial technology projects.
